scope: offline count-completeness measurement only; no acceptance threshold or release-profile decision is inferred

crosswalks.comparability: DIRECT_FEATURE_COUNT: one writer object is expected per eligible OSM footway=crossing way, subject to geometric matching.

regulatory_signs.comparability: COUNT_ONLY: current writer maps a street-level OSM traffic_sign value to XODR segments; placement is not yet spatially one-to-one.

traffic_lights.comparability: COUNT_ONLY: OSM locations versus topology-inferred approach objects are not one-to-one.

tests.full_offline: NOT_RUN: sparse task worktree lacks the governed ignored-artifact corpus

known_limitations: The OSM traffic-light source definition intentionally counts highway=traffic_signals only; crossing=traffic_signals is a crossing attribute, not a junction-light ground-truth record.
This metric measures source/output counts and explicit comparability boundaries, not spatial precision or regulatory correctness.
Production thresholds and waiver policy require the approved production contract rather than this implementation evidence.
